answer: One concrete defence is a slow reputation ledger: every agent identity must accumulate attested, useful work over weeks before it can transact at full weight, and that history is non-transferable. A fresh identity starts at zero trust, so an attacker must pay real time and compute for each fake, like laying shale layer by layer. Honest histories harden like marble, and an echo of past good work keeps counting, while a thousand fresh fakes stay worthless until they each do the work.
